title: 2026-11-05_XMRig_Cryptominer_Investigation_ea5
description: Investigate a compromised Linux host running a cryptocurrency miner, identify the malicious components, and contain the threat.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content:
This scenario presents a compromised Linux host running a cryptocurrency miner. Your task is to investigate the infection, identify the malicious components, and contain the threat.

The compromised host is `miner-host` with IP address `192.168.50.5`. You have SSH access to this host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. To begin the scenario, enter 'start' in the access level.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
To access the sandbox in the cloud, use the following credentials:
Username: cyrano
Password: cyrano
Enter 'start' to begin the scenario.
levels.local_content:
To access the local sandbox, use the following credentials:
Username: cyrano
Password: cyrano
Enter 'start' to begin the scenario.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content: Security monitoring has detected an unusual CPU-intensive process on the compromised host. Investigate the running services and identify the service responsible for the suspicious activity.
levels.solution:
1. Connect to the miner-host using SSH: `ssh cyrano@192.168.50.5`
2. List all services: `systemctl list-units --type=service --all`
3. Identify the suspicious service by looking for unusual service names or high CPU usage
4. Check the status of the suspicious service: `systemctl status bash.service`
5. The hidden flag is `bash.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use `ps aux --sort=-%cpu` to identify the process consuming the most CPU resources.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the service status with `systemctl status <service>`.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Look for services with unusual names or descriptions.

levels.title: Determine Network Port
levels.content: An unfamiliar network service appears to be involved in unauthorized communication with an external system. Investigate the service and determine the network port associated with this communication.
levels.solution:
1. Check the service configuration: `systemctl cat bash.service`
2. Look for the port number in the ExecStart parameter
3. The hidden flag is `3333`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use `ss -tulnp` to list all listening ports.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the service configuration with `systemctl cat <service>`.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Look for the port number in the ExecStart parameter.

levels.title: Identify Persistence Mechanism
levels.content: Investigators suspect that a mechanism keeps the miner service running across reboots and process termination. Determine which system component is responsible for this activity.
levels.solution:
1. Check the service status: `systemctl status bash.service`
2. Look for the path to the cron job file in the output
3. The hidden flag is `/etc/cron.d/sysupdate`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use `grep -Rni . /etc/cron.d/ 2>/dev/null` to search for cron jobs.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the service status with `systemctl status <service>`.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Look for the path to the cron job file in the output.
